about: Every choice for the vocal bars, per verse bar (bar 0 = L1, bar 2 = L2, bar 5 = beats 2-3 'diye bagirir', bar 6 = L4), measured over the sung frames of that line in all 7 verses (note mode). Sorted by J = chord_tone - 2 * (clash_sustained + outside_scale), then fewer chord changes. allowed = false: bar 6 would not end on the dominant or I. sade_shape = the bar obeys the shape rules T1-T3. changes = chord changes inside the bar (bar 5: counted from the I of its beats 0-1). Metric definitions: see olcum.json.

chords_as_played_I_IV_V_in_C.about: the same search with the dominant as a plain triad V (= V7 without its seventh in the band)
